scope: controlled synthetic engineering benchmark only; no production change or closure of #3885

freeze_gate.permission_issuer: main after independent count/coverage/hash validation; architect handback is not generation permission
freeze_gate.changes_after_freeze: preserve old hashes and rationale; pre-search amendments only, re-freeze and independently revalidate

primary_metric.name: NDCG@10
primary_metric.idcg_population: all 180 independently validated corpus records for this query, not retrieved pool
primary_metric.aggregation: mean of 3 paraphrase NDCGs within each intent, then equal mean of 8 heldout intent means; compute separately per seed
primary_metric.zero_idcg: undefined, exclude equally with counts; noanswer diagnostic never included; missing positive coverage blocks recommendation
primary_metric.duplicate_policy: first occurrence retained only for diagnostic arithmetic; any duplicate result ID fails correctness
primary_metric.tie_order: actual engine returned order; never target-aware reranking

promotion_A.critical_displacement_definition: candidate best authoritative-target rank worse than baseline rank for ANY exact query, even if top1 accuracy unchanged; missing top10 target rank is infinity

retain_raw_B.interpretation: raw fusion consistently better in this controlled benchmark only; normalization failing a gate alone does not establish B

conditions: effect below either registered 0.05 consistency bar
candidate exact regression despite semantic gain
correctness failure or unacceptable candidate latency

latency.scope: local warmed retrieval only; exclude metadata generation and embeddings
latency.schedule: deterministic SHA(query_id)-based system rotation with repetition offset; preserve actual schedule and per-request timings
latency.primary_population: same 44 combined heldout positive queries: 24 Asemantic +14 Bexact +6 Bfunctional; exclude development and diagnostics
latency.p95_estimator: linear interpolation at index (n-1)*0.95 in sorted samples, matching inherited #3902 harness
latency.subcohort_with_fewer_than_100_samples: p95 undefined; report n and median only

required: same 180-record corpus/mapping/vectors/query text/permissions/filter/depth per seed across systems
actual production query builder and analyzer evidence
raw_boost1 differs ONLY at root dataset-vector boost
matched boost50 and boost1 normalization attribution
#3900 real-engine and service authorization regressions reused
synthetic visibility and tenant controls additional only
result inclusion and actual ranking audited
nested distribution matches and inner hits retained
topk k1 secondary correctness mode or explicit unsupported failure
neutral quality1 hasQualitytrue per ID across seeds
fixed quality and generic-spatial stress probes report pre-normalization factor placement
correctness.quality_spatial_probe_population: selected local correctness fixtures, not a new relevance experiment
correctness.stress_quality_schedule: fixed per stable ID and identical across seeds; e.g. 0.25/0.6/1, hasQualitytrue; neutral remains1
correctness.stress_spatial_schedule: fixed generic region fixture and fixed query region; no externally fetched region data

secondary: Suite A Success@5 grade>=2 and grade>=3
top10 failure cases with field evidence
hashes, runtime settings and seed realization variation
reporting.confidence_intervals: optional descriptive paired family bootstrap; no population or statistical-significance claim; never replace per-seed bar
